subject: Logic
title: Appeal to Fear
description: A fast breakdown of Appeal to Fear for builders.

hook.text: "If you don't buy this security system, your family is in danger." Fear replaces logic.

buildup.text: Appeal to fear substitutes a threat or scary scenario for actual evidence supporting a claim.

discovery.text: Insurance ads do this relentlessly: imagine the worst, then buy our product to feel safe.

twist.text: Some fears are legitimate. The fallacy kicks in when fear is used instead of evidence, not alongside it.

climax.text: When scared, ask: is the danger real and proportionate? What does the evidence actually show?

punchline.text: Scared isn't the same as informed.

quiz.question: When does appeal to fear become a fallacy?
